title: Preventing Air Lock: The Danger of Double Trapping
description: Installing two drain traps in series on a single fixture drain line is a critical mistake known as double trapping. Plumbing traps rely on gravity and balanced atmospheric pressure to discharge wastewater while maintaining a water seal against sewer gases. When two P-traps are installed sequentially, air becomes trapped between the two water seals. This air lock impedes flow, causes sluggish drainage, and can even siphon out trap seals. To maintain efficient drainage and proper trap function, ensure every fixture discharges through exactly one properly vented trap.
